g.text: The new forests support a fixed cap-correction policy; bars show final policy predictions, not standalone raw-regressor accuracy.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596c7b

g.text: Raw-regressor diagnostics and active-only gates are retained in the report. Candidate selection precedes fresh labels; no post-test model switch.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596c7b

g.text: Eight controls are shared between cohorts. Conditional cases are selected by prediction disagreement; the cohorts are not pooled.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596c7b

g.text: Measured target: isolated iCE40 LUT4 count. This is not a CPU speedup, application-transfer or universal hardware-safety result.
